caption: A group of women are dancing together. They are all dressed in traditional Indian garb. One of the women is in the middle of the group dancing. She is wearing a colorful garb and headdress. The women are holding brown bowls in their hands. There is smoke coming out of the bowls. There are wires hanging above the women.
